episode.title: Just Hold This
episode.scene: Attic living room floor on the sage green rug, bathed in late afternoon golden sunlight. Teddy, a large shaggy apricot Syrian hamster, sits very still on his haunches with a flat, resigned posture, his broad back loaded with a stack of pumpkin seeds and a broad dried oak leaf. Right beside him, Ichigo, a small silvery white dwarf hamster half his size, stands rigidly balanced on all fours with a plump dried rosehip and a curved twig resting across her neat spine. Both hamsters have solid glossy black bead eyes staring straight ahead, completely frozen so nothing falls, surrounded by a scattering of sorting scraps on the floor.
episode.caption: It started with 'hold this for a second' and ended in total mutual paralysis.
episode.arcNote: Teddy and Ichigo accidentally trapped each other into being immobile storage shelves during nest cleanup.
